## Summary

Describe the change and why it is needed.

## Change type

- [ ] Implementation only
- [ ] Methodology or protocol
- [ ] Data source or cohort definition
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Security or privacy

## Validation

List the commands and results used to validate the change.

## Research and safety review

- [ ] No patient-identifying or controlled-access data is included.
- [ ] Clinical or quantum-advantage language remains appropriately bounded.
- [ ] Methodological changes include protocol and regression-test updates.
- [ ] New dependencies and external services are documented.
